Job Summary

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join the Product Management team at Innovatiview India Ltd. The role will be responsible for analyzing product, operational, customer and business data to generate actionable insights that support product strategy, feature development, operational efficiency and business growth.

The candidate will work closely with Product, Technology, Operations and other cross-functional teams to identify trends, measure product performance, develop dashboards and reports, track KPIs, and translate complex datasets into meaningful business recommendations.

The role will involve working with data generated from Innovatiview's technology-enabled solutions across examination security, surveillance, biometric verification, tracking, scanning and related digital platforms.




Key Responsibilities




1. Product Analytics

Analyze product and platform data to evaluate product performance, adoption, usage and effectiveness.
Define and track key product metrics, KPIs and performance indicators.
Monitor user journeys, feature adoption, engagement and drop-off points.
Identify trends, anomalies and opportunities for product improvement.
Conduct cohort, funnel and comparative analysis wherever required.
Support Product Managers in making data-driven product decisions.



2. Business & Operational Analytics

Analyze operational data from examination projects, centers, candidates, deployments and service activities.
Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies and recurring issues through data analysis.
Develop analytical models to measure productivity, utilization, turnaround time and service performance.
Provide insights to improve scalability and efficiency across large-scale deployments.
Support management with data-backed business recommendations.



3. Dashboard & MIS Development

Design and maintain interactive dashboards for Product and Business teams.
Develop dashboards covering product usage, operational performance, revenue-related metrics, customer performance and other business KPIs.
Automate recurring reports and reduce dependency on manual Excel-based reporting.
Ensure dashboards are accurate, user-friendly and updated within defined timelines.
Establish standardized reporting formats and data definitions across functions.



4. Data Analysis & Visualization

Extract, clean, transform and analyze data from multiple sources.
Identify patterns, correlations and trends within large datasets.
Present complex analysis through clear visualizations, charts and dashboards.
Convert analytical findings into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis based on business and product requirements.



5. Product Development Support

Work with Product Managers to define data requirements for new products, features and platforms.
Support development of product KPIs and success metrics before product/feature launches.
Analyze post-launch performance and provide recommendations for optimization.
Assist in A/B testing, feature comparison and performance analysis where applicable.
Support Product Managers in preparing product reports, business cases and performance reviews.



6. Data Quality & Governance

Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, duplication and gaps across systems.
Coordinate with Technology and Engineering teams to resolve data-related issues.
Establish data validation checks and ensure analytical outputs are reliable.
Maintain documentation for datasets, KPIs, dashboards and analytical methodologies.
Handle sensitive examination, candidate and operational data responsibly and in accordance with organizational data-security requirements.

Hands-on experience with data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data structures.
Experience with data quality checks, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Experience working with large datasets and SQL query optimization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with technical and business teams.

Candidates with experience in SQL-heavy Data Analyst, ETL, Data Engineering, or Data Pipeline roles.
Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in SQL rather than primarily working on reporting or dashboard development.
Experience with stored procedures, CTEs, complex joins, query optimization, and data validation will be an advantage.

Important Screening Criteria

SQL is mandatory and should be hands-on and strong.
Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to Power BI/dashboard development without strong SQL and ETL exposure are not suitable.
Profiles primarily focused on PySpark should be avoided.

liquidity ratios (LCR, NSFR)

Good to Have

Scenario modeling & stress testing (what-if analysis)

Lead and oversee the delivery of regulatory reporting activities within a controlled, regulated financial services environment. The role is responsible for ensuring completeness, accuracy, governance, and timely delivery of regulatory reporting outputs across Capital and/or Liquidity / IFRS Reporting / Credit Risk Reporting processes. company reporting covers regulatory submissions required under PRA supervision, including liquidity, capital, stress testing, and statistical returns.

The role provides review, challenge, and oversight across reporting activities delivered through the offshore operating model, ensuring outputs are supported by robust controls, reconciliations, analytical review, and regulatory compliance.








Job Responsibility




1. Manage and perform the review and challenge of regulatory reporting outputs to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

2. Take day-to-day responsibility for execution of daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting processes, ensuring timely delivery in line with agreed processes, controls, and governance standards.

3. Prepare, review, and analyse reconciliations, controls, adjustments, and analytical reporting outputs across the end to end reporting process.

4. Prepare and own required manual adjustments, ensuring they are accurately calculated, appropriately approved, and supported by clear documentation and audit trails.

5. Prepare and review management packs, variance analysis, and commentary for senior stakeholder reporting, ensuring key movements, risks, and issues are clearly articulated.

Controls, Governance & Regulatory Compliance

6. Perform detailed review and challenge of data quality, reporting assumptions, and methodologies, escalating material issues where required.

7. Investigate and resolve complex reporting issues, anomalies, reconciliation differences, and control breaks, working with relevant stakeholders to agree remediation actions.

8. Manage governance and sign-off processes, ensuring reporting outputs are appropriately evidenced, reviewed, and documented.

9. Ensure compliance with PRA expectations, regulatory reporting standards, governance requirements, and submission timelines.

10. Understand regulatory reporting requirements from an operational delivery perspective and assess impacts on reporting processes, data, controls, and outputs.

11. Support responses to regulatory queries, internal audit requests, control reviews, and ad hoc information requests.

12. Manage competing priorities, delivery timelines, issue resolution, and escalation of key reporting risks and issues.

Change, Process Improvement & Implementation

13. Assess the operational impact of regulatory, process, and system changes affecting regulatory reporting processes and outputs.

14. Identify and support process improvements, automation initiatives, and strengthening of reporting controls to improve efficiency, accuracy, and operational resilience.

Team Management & Oversight

15. Provide day-to-day supervision, task allocation, technical guidance, training, and review support to junior colleagues, ensuring work is completed accurately and on time.




A. Capital Reporting Activities (include if applicable):

- Review and challenge COREP returns, including Own Funds, Risk Weighted Assets (RWA), and Capital Ratios (CET1, Tier 1, Total Capital).

- Review capital reconciliations, consolidation adjustments, and regulatory calculations.

- Provide oversight and challenge across ICAAP and Economic Capital reporting activities.

- Ensure capital reporting outputs align with regulatory requirements, internal policy, and governance expectations.

B. Liquidity Reporting



Support the production, review, and submission of liquidity regulatory returns across PRA and ECB requirements as part of the weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting cycle.
Support the full end-to-end liquidity reporting lifecycle, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and traceability of all outputs including Collection of data from Treasury, Risk, Finance, and source systems,
Support preparation of liquidity regulatory returns including PRA110, LCR, NSFR, and ALM, Application of regulatory adjustments, assumptions, and liquidity metrics calculations

C. Regulatory Submissions / Bank of England Reporting.Support preparation and submission of Bank of England / PRA regulatory returns. Exposure to end -to-end IFRS9 model execution and monitoring, supporting Finance and Risk reporting.




D. IFRS 9 Reporting / Credit Risk / Market Risk Reporting - Exposure to end -to-end IFRS9 model execution and monitoring, supporting Finance and Risk reporting, Data aggregation, validation, and reconciliation

Job Summary:
The Business Analyst will play a key role in supporting finance and management information (MI) systems for an insurance company. The individual will bridge the gap between business operations, finance, and IT, ensuring the successful implementation and optimization of finance-related systems and management reporting tools. The role involves gathering business requirements, facilitating communication between stakeholders, and analyzing data to improve decision-making processes within the insurance domain.


Key Responsibilities:
Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders (finance teams, insurance operations, and IT) to gather, document, and translate business requirements into functional specifications.
Process Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in finance and reporting processes, recommending and implementing improvements to streamline workflows in the current system
Data Analysis: Analyze finance and MI data of the current state systems
System Implementation & Support: Support the implementation, integration, and optimization of finance and reporting systems, ensuring alignment with business processes for the new system.
Reporting & MI Development: Design & Develop financial reports and dashboards using MI tools, providing detailed analysis and insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) on the new system
Stakeholder Communication: Act as a liaison between finance, insurance operations, and IT teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project goals and timelines.
Documentation: Create detailed documentation including business requirements, process flows, and functional specifications.
Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure that finance and MI systems adhere to regulatory and compliance standards within the insurance industry.


Required Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Business Analyst in the insurance domain, with a focus on finance and MI.
Strong understanding of insurance products, underwriting, claims processes, and financial reporting.
Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau)
Experience with Agile methodologies and familiarity with project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex data sets.
Strong communication skills to work with cross-functional teams and present findings to stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with regulatory reporting (e.g., Solvency II, IFRS 17) in the insurance industry.
Knowledge of management information systems and their role in insurance operations.
Familiarity with financial modeling and forecasting techniques.


Key Competencies:
Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
Strong business acumen with the ability to understand the financial implications of insurance operations.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence and negotiate with stakeholders.

Role purpose




As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate with project managers, business unit leaders, cross-functional team members, and senior leadership to document, agree upon, and deliver business and technical requirements throughout all project phases. You will support various project activities, prepare briefs for senior leadership, coordinate resources, and balance the workload within portfolio and squad teams.




Your role includes facilitating workshops, gathering feedback, adjusting requirements, and obtaining formal sign-offs. You will ensure high-quality documentation and adherence to project lifecycle standards, methodologies, and practices. Building strong relationship, working in collaborative environments, and navigating ambiguity are key to your success. Additionally, you will work with the portfolio manager to identify and implement improvements to support the portfolio, squads, and functional areas.









Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities










Strategic Focus







Help to define business problems via in-depth investigation and gathering of technical and non-technical information.


Outline detailed requirements for a solution and ensure the delivered solution meets those business requirements.


Apply creative thinking and work collaboratively with teams to solve business challenges.


Traceability between the technical and functional requirements and the development and then testing of same in case of Technology Projects.


Create business level user acceptance criteria for each feature from baseline requirements.


Contribute to ensuring high quality standards through peer review and quality assurance of documents and deliverables.







Operational Management







Gather, validate and document business requirements/use cases.


Analyse data to inform / validate opportunities and requirements.


Model business processes and identify opportunities for process improvements.


Assist with production of specifications that implement the behaviours described by the Project.


Working from the features and needs defined by the project vision, identify requirements/user stories, and use cases that describe the scope of the project.


Ensure that testing is appropriately documented, with evidence recorded.


Understand the customer experience, how they may use the product/service and how that will influence both your Business and Technical Requirements.


Developing, maintaining, and improving Analyst methodologies and processes.


Developing dashboards, graphics, and reports for Portfolio consumption on relevant matters, such as Requirement/Epic/Story cut through.


Analyse backlogs and be aware of upcoming works, potential Analysis synergies that can be created between projects within the portfolios for efficiency gains.


Store and Host the Business Requirements and Technical requirements in a way that continually builds out the knowledge base for future project use.


Make portfolio level recommendations pertaining to workplace continuous improvement opportunities, role efficiency gains, as well as other aspects of delivery as and when the opportunity arises.







People Leadership







Identify stakeholders and facilitate discussions or workshops with the purpose of eliciting and understanding stakeholder needs, requirements, and priorities.


Provide leadership to team members and peers through collaboration, mentoring and knowledge sharing.


Driving the resolution of issues through engagement of peers and stakeholders across project and business functions


Hold self and team accountable for results with a strong focus on delivering value.


Build productive and professional relationships with key stakeholders, other cross-functional team members and Senior Leadership roles.


Chair and facilitate a centre of excellence for the Analyst roles across the division.


Creatively work collaboratively with teams to solve business challenges, further supporting the documentation of clear, concise and accurate requirements.







Governance & Risk







Identify issues, risks and benefits of existing and proposed solutions and outline business impacts.


Drive business improvements through visibility of ongoing quality issues and initiatives.


Review team working practices/procedures to identify opportunities to improve quality or productivity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Marketing Specialist , a generalist who is fluent across SEO/AEO, paid social and search, and CRO, and who keeps marketing projects moving. Day to day, the job is about coordination and follow-through: managing timelines, keeping teams aligned, and turning performance data into next steps. Depending on what a given project needs, you may also roll up your sleeves and work directly in any of these areas, so you should know each of them well enough to do that, even though owning any single channel long-term isn't the core of the role.

What Youll Do

Plan and coordinate marketing projects end to end: timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across SEO, paid media, content, design, and development.
Act as the point of contact between everyone working on a given marketing initiative, keeping the team aligned and unblocked.
Build and maintain project trackers, timelines, and status reports so stakeholders always know where things stand.
Monitor performance across SEO/AEO, paid, and CRO channels, flag what needs attention, and turn the data into clear next steps.
Prepare performance dashboards and reporting decks for stakeholders and leadership.
Where a project calls for it, contribute hands-on to SEO/AEO work such as content briefs, technical audits, and keyword or query research.
Where a project calls for it, support social and search advertising campaigns, from setup through budget tracking and reporting.
Where a project calls for it, support CRO work such as landing page testing, funnel analysis, and A/B tests.
Stay current with SEO/AEO, paid media, CRO, and AI-driven marketing tools and best practices.



Required Skills & Qualifications

2–4 years of experience in digital marketing, with real exposure to project coordination alongside hands-on channel work.
Solid working understanding of SEO and AEO/GEO (answer and generative engine optimization) principles.
Practical understanding of social and search advertising platforms and how campaigns are planned, run, and measured.
Working knowledge of CRO principles, testing methods, and funnel optimization.
Strong project management skills and the discipline to keep several workstreams on track at once.
Comfortable being a generalist: able to move between SEO, paid, CRO, and coordination work rather than specializing in just one.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills

The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

Interest in business and commerciality.

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Role: Product Marketing and Go to Market Intelligence Analyst

Location: Noida, India

Website: www.SEW.ai

Research | Product Marketing | Account Intelligence | Account Based Marketing | Analytics | Go to Market Engineering

Who We Are

SEW.AI is a Vertical Artificial Intelligence platform company serving energy and water providers globally. Our platforms connect customer, workforce, grid and business operations to improve service, productivity and operational outcomes. We work with more than 470 utilities across more than 47 countries, connecting over 1.4 billion people with essential services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on analyst who can turn market, product, account and performance data into clear go to market decisions. This role sits at the intersection of research, product marketing, account based marketing, digital analytics and go to market operations.

You will build the intelligence layer that helps SEW.AI identify priority markets and accounts, sharpen product positioning, improve digital journeys, activate targeted programs and equip sales teams with timely, relevant insight. The role is suited to a commercially minded builder who is equally comfortable with research, writing, data and systems.

What You Will Own

Market Research and Competitive Intelligence

Track market shifts, buyer priorities, regulatory themes, technology adoption and patterns across the global energy and water industry.
Build competitor and category intelligence covering positioning, products, use cases, partnerships, campaigns, customer proof and go to market activity.
Convert research into market maps, audience insights, opportunity assessments, executive briefs and recommendations that teams can act on.

Product Marketing and Launch Intelligence

Develop a strong understanding of SEW.AI platforms, product capabilities, customer journeys, buyer roles and business value across customer, workforce, grid, payments and business operations.
Create positioning, messaging, value propositions, competitive comparisons, launch briefs, sales narratives and customer proof for priority products and solutions.
Partner with product, sales, solutions and customer teams to prepare launches, validate messages, capture market feedback and improve enablement materials.

Account Intelligence and Account Based Marketing

Build account selection and prioritization models using firmographic, technology, intent, engagement, relationship and opportunity signals.
Create account briefs, buying committee maps, stakeholder profiles, whitespace views and personalized value hypotheses for priority accounts.
Support one to one, one to few and scaled account based marketing programs with relevant research, content, activation plans and performance insight.
Work with sales and revenue operations to improve account coverage, engagement, progression, pipeline influence and expansion visibility.

Website and Marketing Analytics

Analyze website traffic, audience behavior, search performance, content journeys, conversion paths and campaign landing pages to identify growth opportunities.
Build and maintain dashboards for channel performance, campaign outcomes, account engagement, funnel movement, pipeline contribution and return on marketing investment.
Define measurement standards including campaign naming, tracking parameters, conversion events, lead and account scoring, benchmarks and reporting cadence.
Translate data into decisions by explaining what changed, why it matters and which action should follow.

Go to Market Engineering and Automation

Design practical workflows across customer relationship management, marketing automation, web analytics, enrichment, intent, business intelligence and sales engagement systems.
Build automations for research, data enrichment, audience creation, lead and account routing, personalization, alerts, reporting and follow-up.
Improve data quality, taxonomy, system documentation and reusable playbooks so marketing and sales teams can operate with greater speed and consistency.
Apply Artificial Intelligence responsibly to research, analysis, content operations, quality checks and workflow automation while maintaining human review.

Cross Functional Delivery

Prepare weekly and monthly intelligence updates that connect market activity, account signals, digital performance and go to market priorities.
Manage multiple workstreams with clear ownership, accurate documentation and reliable delivery timelines.

How Success Will Be Measured

Quality and adoption of market, competitor and account intelligence across marketing, product and sales teams.
Readiness and effectiveness of product launches, messaging and sales enablement.
Growth in priority account coverage, engagement, meeting creation, opportunity progression and pipeline influence.
Improvement in website conversion, campaign performance, reporting reliability and time to insight.
Efficiency gained through better data, connected workflows and repeatable go to market automation.

Basic Qualifications

Three to six years of experience in product marketing, market research, account based marketing, marketing analytics, marketing operations, go to market strategy or a related role within enterprise technology or software.
Strong research capability with the judgment to separate useful signals from noise and turn findings into a clear commercial point of view.
Hands-on experience with website analytics, customer relationship management, marketing automation, data visualization, spreadsheet modeling and campaign measurement.
Understanding of business to business buying journeys, account prioritization, buying committees, funnel stages and pipeline reporting.
Ability to create clear product messaging, value propositions, launch materials, sales enablement and executive ready analysis.
Strong quantitative thinking, structured problem solving, attention to detail and comfort working with imperfect data.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work across technical, commercial and leadership teams.
Undergraduate degree in marketing, business, economics, engineering, computer science, data analytics or a related discipline. A postgraduate degree is preferred.

Preferred Experience

Experience in the energy, water, utility, infrastructure or regulated industry ecosystem.
Experience connecting marketing activity to account engagement, opportunity movement and revenue outcomes.

The Mindset We Value

Curious, precise and commercially aware. You ask better questions, test assumptions, build useful systems and communicate findings in a way that helps teams decide and act.

Basic understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, and software development concepts.
Exposure to SQL Server, cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, and enterprise application integration is desirable.
Hands-on experience managing software development projects using Agile/Scrum and SDLC methodologies.
Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar platforms.
Possess ability to translate business requirements into executable project plans.
Excellent skills in project planning, estimation, scheduling, risk management, and resource allocation.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve conflicts, and drive teams toward successful project outcomes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership capabilities.
Strong ownership and accountability for project delivery.
Proactive communication and effective management of client expectations.
Ability to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Focus on timely delivery, quality, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

EY- Assurance - Senior Associate

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity

We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Job description

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs):

1. Multi-Project Coordination & Execution

Own and track project timelines, milestones, and deliverables across 46 simultaneous client implementations.
Maintain and update project plans weekly in coordination with functional, engineering, QA, and client teams.
Flag and follow up on slippages, risks, or delays proactively.
Ensure all internal and external teams are aligned to planned Go-Live dates.

2. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

Prepare and share structured weekly project status reports (internal & client-facing) including progress, blockers, next steps, and accountability matrix.
Escalate issues or misalignments early with actionable resolution options.
Schedule and manage cadence calls, MOMs, and follow-up actions effectively.

3. Dependency Identification & Risk Management

Track dependencies across product customizations, engineering tickets, and release schedules.
Identify bottlenecks in cross-functional teams (product, QA, data, infrastructure) early and facilitate resolution.
Maintain a risk register and actively update mitigation plans in collaboration with project owners.

4. Change Management & Customization Oversight

Monitor all approved and in-scope change requests, ensuring documentation, estimates, and timelines are captured.
Liaise with product/engineering for feature changes, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and release timelines.
Ensure no scope creep without written change sign-offs.

5. Documentation & Internal Alignment

Maintain up-to-date internal trackers for each project across Jira, Confluence, Freshdesk, Excel, or other internal tools.
Ensure all documentation BRDs, SOWs, test plans, Go-Live checklists are centrally stored and version-controlled.
Collaborate with QA and support for a clean handover and post-Go-Live tracking.

6. Customer & Business Understanding

Demonstrate working knowledge of ecommerce operations, omnichannel use cases, and Vinculums product modules.
Engage in basic process mapping to capture gaps in client expectations vs product capabilities.
Support project managers in driving adoption of core modules and minimizing unnecessary customizations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

% Projects delivered on-time and within scope.
No. of weekly reports delivered without delay.
% of risks and dependencies identified proactively.
Client satisfaction score (post-implementation).
Internal SLA adherence across engineering/product coordination.

What new IT products are trending globally?
What customer problems are startups solving in each region?

Curiosity + problem-solving mindset.

An MIS (Management Information Systems) Executive in Finance acts as the bridge between raw financial data and senior management. Their primary role is to collect, analyze, and transform financial data into structured reports that help leadership make strategic business decisions.




The core roles and responsibilities are broken down by category below:




Data Management & Reporting

Financial Report Generation: Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly financial reports (e.g., P&L statements, balance sheets, cash flow tracking, and variance analysis).

Data Automation: Streamline data collection processes to reduce manual errors and speed up the financial reporting cycle.

Budgeting & Financial Control

Budget Tracking: Consistently track actual company expenditures against the allocated departmental budgets.
Variance Analysis: Identify discrepancies between budgeted figures and actual spend, highlighting cost overruns or savings to management.
Forecasting Support: Provide historical financial data trends and predictive metrics to assist finance managers in quarterly and annual forecasting.



Operational Coordination

Cross-Departmental Data Collection: Coordinate with departments like Sales, Procurement, and HR to gather transaction data and financial logs.
Audit & Compliance Support: Package financial data, historical logs, and internal quality metrics into compliant formats for external auditors or internal tax teams.
Database Maintenance: Support backend accounting and ERP databases (like SAP, Oracle, Tally, or customized systems) to ensure data is properly archived and secure.



Required Technical Skills

Advanced Excel: Master Level (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query, Macros/VBA).
BI & ERP Software: Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, SAP, Tally Prime, or Oracle Financials.
Database Queries: Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge for extracting data directly from databases.

Role & responsibilities

The Business Analyst in the CEO Office will be the analytical engine behind strategic projects for Havells' leadership. The role suits an early-career consultant (1 to 2 years at a top-tier firm) who is strong at data analysis, structured problem solving and synthesis, and wants to move from advising clients to shaping decisions inside one of India's leading electrical and consumer durables companies.

Working with the CEO Office team and senior leadership, the analyst will build fact bases, model scenarios, frame problems and turn complex analysis into crisp recommendations across Havells' businesses (cables and wires, switchgear, lighting, fans, appliances and Lloyd consumer durables).

Key responsibilities

1. Data analysis and fact-base building

Build and maintain analytical models in Excel to size markets, track business performance and test hypotheses.
Clean, structure and analyse large internal datasets (sales, channel, pricing, cost, dealer and electrician data) to surface insights.
Monitor key business KPIs and build leadership dashboards that flag trends, gaps and exceptions early.
Benchmark Havells against domestic and global peers on growth, margins, channel and operating metrics.

2. Conceptual problem solving

Break down ambiguous leadership questions into structured issue trees and hypotheses, then design the analysis to answer them.
Support operational improvement projects by mapping processes, quantifying inefficiencies and estimating impact of fixes.
Contribute to cost optimisation, pricing, portfolio and channel strategy work across business units.

3. Synthesis and communication

Convert analysis into clear storylines and consulting-grade presentations for the CEO and business heads.
Draft concise memos, board and review notes, and one-page summaries with a clear "so what".
Prepare business cases for new products, investments and initiatives for leadership approval.

4. Strategic initiatives, partnerships and GTM

Conduct market, competitor and customer research to support partnership, collaboration and inorganic opportunity screening.
Support go-to-market strategy and new product launches with segmentation, pricing analysis and post-launch performance tracking.
Assist in preparing proposals, MoUs and evaluation frameworks alongside senior team members.

5. Project and stakeholder support

Coordinate with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, product, finance, supply chain) to gather data and drive workstreams to closure.
Track project milestones, action items and outcomes from leadership reviews.
Support digital transformation and automation initiatives, including use of AI and analytics tools in decision making.

Preferred candidate profile

B.Tech / BE from a reputed engineering institute, followed by an MBA (Not necessary)
Strong academic record with evidence of quantitative aptitude.

Experience

1 to 2 years of experience in a management consulting firm. Experience gained after undergraduation (pre-MBA) and after post-graduation (post-MBA) are both relevant, and can be combined.
Track record of delivering analysis-heavy workstreams on strategy, operations, commercial excellence, cost or due diligence engagements.
Exposure to manufacturing, industrials, consumer durables, FMEG or B2B2C businesses is a plus.

Job Title: VMS Executive - US Staffing

Location: [Noida (Onsite)]

Job Type: Full-Time

Shift Timings: 7:00 PM- 4:00 AM EST Shift




Job Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented VMS Executive to support our US Staffing operations. As a VMS Executive, you will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of the VMS process, from requisition submission to candidate onboarding. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth communication and operations between vendors, clients, and internal teams, while also driving operational efficiency and compliance within our US staffing processes.




Key Responsibilities:

VMS Management: Oversee the full-cycle management of client requisitions through VMS platforms (e.g., Fieldglass, Beeline, etc.), ensuring accurate submission, tracking, and fulfillment of staffing needs.
Client/Vendor Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for client VMS systems, addressing inquiries and resolving any issues that arise between clients and staffing vendors.
Job Order Management: Monitor and manage the job order process, ensuring timely and accurate candidate submissions for client requisitions.
Candidate Screening & Submission: Review candidate profiles submitted by vendors, ensuring they meet the clients job specifications and compliance requirements.
Compliance & Documentation: Ensure all staffing processes adhere to legal, regulatory, and client-specific compliance standards, including background checks, certifications, and other required documentation.
Performance Monitoring: Track and report on VMS metrics, vendor performance, and candidate placement timelines to ensure efficiency and success.
Vendor Management: Collaborate with staffing agencies and vendors to resolve escalations, improve quality, and strengthen relationships.
Client Reporting: Provide timely and detailed reports to clients, highlighting recruitment activity, candidate pipeline, and any outstanding issues.
Training & Support: Offer training and guidance to vendors and internal stakeholders on using VMS platforms, ensuring smooth operations and consistency.



Requirements:

Experience: 1-3 years of experience in VMS management, staffing, or recruitment operations, preferably in the US staffing industry.
VMS Platforms: Familiarity with VMS platforms such as Fieldglass, Beeline, or others.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with vendors, clients, and internal teams.
Detail-Oriented: Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot issues related to the VMS, client/vendor concerns, and other staffing challenges.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook) and experience with VMS systems.
Knowledge of Staffing Compliance: Basic understanding of US staffing and recruitment compliance, including background checks, E-Verify, and I-9 documentation.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience is preferred.



Preferred Qualifications:

Knowledge of specific VMS systems (e.g., Fieldglass, Beeline, etc.).
Experience working with large clients and multiple vendors.
Strong analytical skills for performance tracking and reporting.
Knowledge of recruitment trends and best practices in the staffing industry.



Why Join Us:

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work with a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
Career growth and development opportunities.
Work with leading clients in the staffing industry.

Project Coordinator Operations - AI Data Collection & Annotation

Location: Gurgaon — 5 Days WFO + 1 Day WFH
Experience: 6 months – 2 years
Role Type: Individual Contributor (Execution-focused)




About the Role

We are hiring a Project Coordinator – Operations to support and execute AI data collection and annotation projects used for training machine learning models.

This role is strongly execution-driven and focused on day-to-day project operations, coordination, quality checks, and delivery tracking. You will work closely with internal teams and contributors to ensure tasks are completed accurately, on time, and as per defined guidelines.

This position offers a clear growth path toward team handling and client-facing responsibilities based on performance and ownership demonstrated over time.

This is a non-technical role.




Key Responsibilities




Project Execution & Coordination

Support end-to-end execution of AI data collection and annotation projects
Break down project requirements into clear, actionable instructions
Coordinate daily task execution and follow-ups
Ensure deliverables meet defined timelines and guidelines

Operations Tracking & Documentation

Maintain trackers for submissions, approvals, rework, and closures
Monitor daily throughput and flag delays or risks early
Update internal sheets, trackers, and documentation regularly
Ensure proper file naming, folder structure, and metadata consistency

Quality & Compliance Support

Perform basic quality checks before final submissions
Ensure data complies with the provided guidelines and formats
Coordinate corrections and rework where required
Escalate quality issues clearly and in a timely manner

Team Coordination

Coordinate with internal contributors and project teams
Share clear instructions and ensure task clarity
Track daily productivity and adherence to timelines
Assist in onboarding contributors into active projects



Who Should Apply

You are a good fit if you:

Have 6 months to 2 years of experience in operations, project coordination, delivery support, or execution roles
Are highly detail-oriented and process-driven
Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and structured workflows
Can manage multiple tasks and follow-ups simultaneously
Take ownership of assigned work and close tasks independently
Are eager to grow into team-handling and client-facing roles over time

Exposure to AI data collection, annotation, content operations, or large-scale coordination is a plus but not mandatory.




Work Hours & Flexibility

Standard working hours (8–10 hours/day)
Occasional flexibility may be required based on project needs for working in the US shift whenever required.



Growth & Learning

Clear progression from execution support to independent project ownership
Opportunity to grow into team handling and client-facing roles
Hands-on exposure to real-world AI data operations at scale



Why Join Us

Work on global AI data projects across multiple data types
Learn structured execution in high-volume operations
Fast-paced environment with strong learning exposure
Direct visibility with leadership and ownership-based growth
About ConsultBae
ConsultBae is a global services firm working across AI data collection & annotation and recruitment operations, supporting clients in building high-quality datasets for AI and machine learning systems.
We operate large-scale, execution-driven projects across multiple data types and geographies, with a strong focus on process, quality, and operational excellence.

Project Operations & Client Delivery AI Data Collection & Annotation (Non-Technical Role)




Location: Gurgaon (5 Days WFO + 1 Day WFH)
Experience: 0.6 4 Years
Industry: AI Data Services / Operations / Delivery

About the Role




We are hiring for Project Operations & Client Delivery in our AI Data Services vertical.




This is a non-technical, execution-heavy role focused on managing large-scale AI data collection and annotation projects used to train machine learning models.

Depending on your experience, you may join under one of the following tracks:

Track A – Project Operations (0.6–2 years experience)
Track B – Client Delivery & Project Lead (1–4 years experience)



Both tracks own projects end-to-end. The difference lies in the level of client interaction and team handling responsibility.

Important Clarification




This is NOT a software development or technical project management role.
You will NOT manage developers or write code.

This role is operations-driven and execution-focused, managing freelancers, vendors, quality, timelines, and delivery for AI data projects.

Track A – Project Operations (Execution-Focused)




Best suited for candidates with 6 months – 2 years experience in operations, coordination, delivery support, BPO/KPO, or similar roles.

Key Responsibilities:

Source and onboard freelancers across multiple channels
Break down project requirements into clear execution steps
Maintain daily trackers (submissions, QC, approvals, rework, closures)
Monitor throughput and flag risks early
Coordinate corrections and ensure compliance with guidelines
Maintain proper file naming, folder structures, and metadata accuracy
Solve operational bottlenecks independently



Growth Path:

High performers will be groomed into Client Delivery / Project Lead roles within 6-9 months based on ownership and performance.

Track B – Client Delivery & Project Lead




Best suited for candidates with 1–4 years of experience in client handling, delivery management, outsourcing, BPO/KPO, IT services, digital agencies, or project-based environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Act as primary point of contact for clients
Understand requirements and translate them into execution plans
Own delivery timelines, quality, and client satisfaction
Manage coordinators, interns, freelancers, and vendors
Track daily throughput and identify risks proactively
Conduct review calls and manage escalations
Improve workflows for faster and more accurate execution

What Kind of Candidate Will Succeed Here

You will do well if you:

Enjoy solving operational challenges
Can manage multiple moving parts simultaneously
Are highly detail-oriented and process-driven
Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions
Can work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
Are comfortable using spreadsheets and structured workflows
Can figure out sourcing strategies independently

Exposure to AI data collection, annotation, or large-scale coordination is a plus but not mandatory.

Work Timing & Flexibility

Standard working hours (8–10 hours/day)
Some projects may require occasional overlap with US time zones
